name: UX playground
lead: Compose the coded components in a layout before a prototype

phases.title: Have an idea
phases.actions: Has a need (a screen to explore, a feature to test) and opens the documentation site.

phases.title: Open the playground
phases.actions: Finds the UX playground space in the navigation, opens it and sees the existing compositions.

phases.title: Create a composition
phases.actions: Creates a new composition and names it.

phases.title: Compose
phases.actions: Adds frames (mobile, tablet, desktop), opens the component library, drags components into a frame, places them on the grid and moves them.

phases.title: Adjust
phases.actions: Selects a placed component and changes its variants, states, texts and tokens (that component only): another approved token or a free value marked not approved.

phases.title: Annotate
phases.actions: Adds sticky notes on the canvas and comments on a component or a frame.

phases.title: Save and share
phases.actions: Saves the composition in the repository; the team reopens it from the list.

phases.title: Turn into a prototype or a ticket
phases.actions: Chooses Create the prototype (ticket and prototype) or Add to the backlog (ticket only); the ticket waits for the Design System Lead's validation and takes over the composition.
phases.touchpoints: Two buttons on the canvas, Backlog, Prototypes space
